definition: The MCP server is written from the Model Context Protocol specification revisions 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05: JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes and errors, initialize with version negotiation, ping, tools list and call, resources templates and read, standard input and output transport with one message per line, and the Streamable HTTP transport with Mcp-Session-Id sessions, 202 for notifications, 400 for an unsupported protocol header, and session deletion. Verified by the protocol unit tests and by the end-to-end suite that drives the real binary over both transports. rmcp is gone from Cargo.lock.
